 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Mathur
Judgment 20/07/2023

The instant appeal has been filed under Section 14 A Sc and St (Prevention
of Atrocities) Act on behalf of the appellant, who is in custody in connection with F.I.R. No.22/2023,
registered at Police Station Kotada, District Udaipur for the offences under Sections 313, 376(2)(N)
Ipc and Sections 3(1)(w), 3(2)(va) of the Sc and St (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against the order
dated 20.05.2023 passed by the learned Special Judge Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
(Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases Udaipur whereby, the bail application preferred under Section
439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the appellant was rejected.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned public prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

[CRLAS-828/2023] Drawing attention of the court towards the statements of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the prosecutrix developed consensual sexual relationship with the present petitioner.
Learned counsel submitted that the allegation against the appellant is that he promised to marry the prosecutrix and developed physical relationship under the fictitious assurance.

Learned counsel submitted that as a matter of fact, prosecutrix as per her own statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has stated that she remained in the company of appellant for more than two and half years.

Learned counsel Ajruddin @ Joni vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125898007/
1 submitted that there is nothing on record which would indicate that the appellant forced the prosecutrix to enter into relationship with him.

entities.text: Ajruddin @ Joni vs State Of Rajasthan
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that prosecutrix freely exercised her choice of voluntarily and consciously developing consensual sexual relationship with the present petitioner.

Learned counsel submitted that the appellant has been roped in the present criminal case by the prosecutrix when she got pregnant, with a view to create pressure upon the appellant to tie the nuptial knot with her.
Challan of the case has already been filed.
It was submitted that the appellant is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-appellant.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the prayer for bail.

Having regard to the entirety of facts and circumstances as available on record and upon a consideration of the arguments (3 of 3)
[CRLAS-828/2023] advanced at the bar, this Court is of the opinion that the order rejecting the application for bail filed on behalf of the appellant, cannot be sustained and deserves to be set aside.
Consequently, the instant appeal is allowed.
The impugned order dated 20.05.2023 passed by the learned Special Judge Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases Udaipur is set aside.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases Udaipur
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
It is ordered that the accused- appellant Ajruddin @ Joni S/o Shri Shamshuddin arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.22/2023, registered at Police Station Kotada,
District Udaipur shall be released on bail; provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/-
and two surety bonds of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 298-Prashant/-
